## Critical Prerequisite: `IFileSystem` Injection Seam

Stories S3-03, S3-04, S3-05, and S3-08 **cannot be tested without** an `IFileSystem` interface injected into `SaveSystem`. Create this before implementing any write story.

**Interface contract** (minimum):
```csharp
public interface IFileSystem
{
    void WriteAllBytes(string path, byte[] bytes);     // used for FileStream simulation
    void Replace(string src, string dst, string backup);
    void Move(string src, string dst);
    void Delete(string path);
    bool Exists(string path);
    // Configurable fault injection for tests:
    Exception FaultOnNextWrite { get; set; }  // throws on next Write call
    TimeSpan WriteDelay { get; set; }         // simulates slow I/O
}
```

**File locations**:
- `src/SaveSystem/IFileSystem.cs` — production interface
- `tests/helpers/save-persistence/FakeFileSystem.cs` — test double with fault injection

## Automated Tests Required

### S3-02 — SP: SaveData Schema + SaveSystem Boot
**Test file**: `tests/unit/save-persistence/SaveSystem_Boot_Test.cs`
**Estimated test count**: ~12 unit tests
**GDD refs**: AC-13, AC-15, AC-18, AC-19, AC-27, AC-32, AC-33; GDD C.5 singleton guard

#### Test cases

**Boot_R1_ValidV1File_LoadsAllFields**
GIVEN `save.json` with `schema_version = 1`, `current_level_id = 5`, `coin_balance = 150`, `completion_record` with 2 entries
WHEN `SaveSystem.Awake()` executes
THEN in-memory fields match file values exactly, `IsReady = true` (AC-13)

**Boot_R3_NoFile_DefaultsAndNoWrite**
GIVEN no `save.json` at `persistentDataPath`
WHEN `SaveSystem.Awake()` executes
THEN `GetCurrentLevelId() = 1`, `completion_record[] = []`, `GetCoinBalance() = 0`, `IsReady = true`, no file written (AC-15)

**Boot_IsReady_Debug_ThrowsBeforeReady**
GIVEN `SaveSystem` not yet initialized (DEBUG build)
WHEN any read method called before `IsReady`
THEN `InvalidOperationException` thrown immediately (AC-19)

**Boot_IsReady_Release_StallsAndReturnsNullable**
GIVEN `SaveSystem` not yet initialized (RELEASE build)
WHEN read method called, timeout elapses (2s)
THEN nullable result returned — no silent `0` or `false` default (AC-19)

**Boot_SingletonGuard_SecondAwakeDestroyseDuplicate**
GIVEN `SaveSystem` already initialized
WHEN a second `Awake()` fires on a duplicate GameObject
THEN the duplicate is destroyed, cold-start logic does NOT re-run, `IsReady` state unchanged (GDD C.5)

**Boot_EmptyCompletionRecord_NotAnError**
GIVEN `save.json` with `schema_version = 1`, `completion_record = []`
WHEN cold start executes
THEN `IsReady = true`, no error, `current_level_id` loads correctly (AC-32)

**Boot_TmpPresentWithValidJson_TmpDeleted**
GIVEN `save.json` valid, `save.tmp` also present
WHEN cold start executes
THEN `save.json` loaded, `save.tmp` deleted silently before `IsReady = true` (AC-33)

**Boot_NegativeCoinBalance_ClampedToZero**
GIVEN `save.json` with `coin_balance = -50`
WHEN cold start executes
THEN in-memory `coin_balance = 0`, anomaly logged to analytics, all other fields intact (AC-27)

**Boot_OnSaveReady_SubscribeAfterReady_StillFires**
GIVEN `SaveSystem.IsReady = true` already
WHEN a system subscribes to `OnSaveReady` (subscribe-then-check pattern)
THEN the subscriber receives the event immediately (GDD C.5 initialization sequencing)

**Boot_AsyncVoidAwake_ForbiddenPattern_CompileCheck**
WHEN `SaveSystem.Awake()` method signature is inspected via reflection
THEN method is `void Awake()`, not `async void Awake()` (control manifest forbidden pattern)

### S3-03 — SP: Atomic Write W-1 Background Thread
**Test file**: `tests/unit/save-persistence/SaveSystem_AtomicWrite_Test.cs`
**Estimated test count**: ~14 unit tests
**GDD refs**: AC-03, AC-04, AC-05, AC-12, AC-30, AC-37, AC-39, AC-43, AC-46; GDD C.1, C.4

#### Test cases

**Write_W1_SingleFileMovePerCall**
GIVEN injected `FakeFileSystem` tracking all `Move`/`Replace` calls
WHEN `WriteCompletionAtomic(N, 3, "2026.05", N+1)` executes
THEN exactly one `File.Replace` or `File.Move` occurs — never zero, never two (AC-03)

**Write_W1_ReplaceWhenFileExists_MoveForFirstWrite**
GIVEN `save.json` already exists (first case) OR does not exist (second case)
WHEN `WriteCompletionAtomic` executes
THEN `File.Replace(tmp, save, null)` used when file exists; `File.Move(tmp, save)` (2-arg) for first write; 3-arg `File.Move(src, dst, true)` NEVER called (control manifest)

**Write_W1_IOException_SaveJsonIntact_TmpDeleted**
GIVEN `FakeFileSystem.FaultOnNextWrite = IOException` injected on `File.Replace`
WHEN `WriteCompletionAtomic` executes
THEN `save.json` unchanged, `save.tmp` deleted, dirty flag remains `true`, error logged to analytics (AC-37)

**Write_W1_UnauthorizedAccessException_CaughtSeparately**
GIVEN `FakeFileSystem` throws `UnauthorizedAccessException` on `File.Replace`
WHEN `WriteCompletionAtomic` executes
THEN caught by explicit `catch(UnauthorizedAccessException)` block (NOT `catch(IOException)`), same recovery as AC-37 (AC-46)

**Write_W1_ConcurrentSecondW1_BothRecordsPresent**
GIVEN `FakeFileSystem.WriteDelay = 100ms` injected
WHEN W-1 fires for level N, then W-1 fires for level N+1 before the first completes
THEN `save.json` after all writes: both completion records present, `current_level_id = N+2`, valid JSON (AC-05)

**Write_W1_W2_Concurrent_NoDeadlockAndValidJson**
GIVEN `FakeFileSystem.WriteDelay = 50ms`
WHEN W-1 and W-2 fire in the same frame
THEN `_writeLock` prevents concurrent rename; `save.json` valid after both writes; W-2 dirty-check fires after W-1 releases lock (AC-30)

**Write_W1_BackgroundThread_AssertedAtFileStream**
GIVEN `FakeFileSystem` captures the executing thread at `FileStream` construction point
WHEN W-1 executes (after second `Awaitable.BackgroundThreadAsync()`)
THEN `Thread.IsBackground == true` AND thread is NOT the Unity main thread (AC-43)

**Write_W1_SnapshotIsolation_PostSnapshotMutationNotWritten**
GIVEN snapshot captured on main thread at time T showing 5 undo entries
WHEN GSM adds a 6th entry between snapshot and W-1 I/O completing
THEN `save.json` contains exactly 5 undo entries — the post-snapshot mutation is not reflected (GDD C.1 step 1)

**Write_W1_DiskFull_IOException_NonBlockingMessage**
GIVEN `FakeFileSystem` throws `IOException` on `FileStream.Flush`
WHEN W-1 executes
THEN `IOException` caught, non-blocking "Could not save progress — please free up storage space" message shown, error logged to analytics, game remains playable (AC-12)

**Write_W1_LockReleasedInFinally_AfterSerializationThrows**
GIVEN `FakeFileSystem` throws mid-serialization
WHEN exception propagates
THEN `_writeLock.Release()` is called in `finally` block; subsequent write calls can acquire the semaphore (GDD C.1)

**Write_W1_UndoStack_ExactSnapshotWritten**
GIVEN GSM has 5 undo entries at snapshot time
WHEN W-1 executes
THEN `save.json` contains `level_progress.undo_stack` with exactly those 5 entries in correct order (AC-39)

### S3-04 — SP: iOS Cold-Start File Protection Retry
**Test file**: `tests/unit/save-persistence/SaveSystem_ReadCases_Test.cs`
**Estimated test count**: ~10 unit tests
**GDD refs**: AC-16, AC-28, AC-33, AC-44; GDD C.5 cases R-1, R-3, R-4

#### Test cases

**Read_UnauthorizedAccessException_RetriesUntilAccessible**
GIVEN `FakeFileSystem` throws `UnauthorizedAccessException` on first 2 reads, succeeds on 3rd
WHEN cold start executes
THEN file loads successfully on 3rd attempt; all fields correct (AC-28 simulated pass case)

**Read_UnauthorizedAccessException_Timeout_FallsBackToDefaults**
GIVEN `FakeFileSystem` throws `UnauthorizedAccessException` on every read for >5 seconds
WHEN cold start executes
THEN falls back to defaults, `first_unlock_read_failure` analytics event emitted, no file written during retry window (AC-28 fail case)

**Read_IOException_CaughtSeparatelyFromUnauthorized**
GIVEN `FakeFileSystem` throws `IOException` on first read
WHEN cold start executes
THEN caught by explicit `catch(IOException)` block (NOT retry loop); separate handler from `UnauthorizedAccessException` (GDD C.4, control manifest)

**Read_R4_JsonParseFailure_TmpRecovery**
GIVEN `save.json` with corrupted JSON, `save.tmp` with valid JSON
WHEN cold start executes
THEN `save.tmp` used as recovered state, written back to `save.json`, `IsReady = true`, no error UI (AC-16)

**Read_R4_BothFilesCorrupt_DefaultsLoaded**
GIVEN both `save.json` and `save.tmp` fail JSON parsing
WHEN cold start executes
THEN both errors logged, defaults loaded, default state written to `save.json`, `IsReady = true` (AC-44)

**Read_RetryInterval_AtMost20Attempts**
GIVEN `FakeFileSystem` throws `UnauthorizedAccessException` indefinitely
WHEN cold start retry loop runs for 5000ms timeout
THEN at most `floor(5000/250) = 20` retry attempts made (GDD Tuning Knobs)

**Read_RetryLoop_DoesNotBlockMainThread**
GIVEN retry loop is active
WHEN retry wait executes
THEN execution yields (coroutine or `Awaitable.WaitForSecondsAsync`) — no synchronous `Thread.Sleep` call on main thread (GDD Tuning Knobs)

### S3-05 — SP: W-2 Synchronous OnApplicationPause Write
**Test file**: `tests/integration/save-persistence/SaveSystem_Pause_Test.cs`
**Estimated test count**: ~9 integration tests
**GDD refs**: AC-06, AC-07, AC-08, AC-09, AC-42; GDD C.1 W-2; control manifest async void forbidden

#### Test cases

**Pause_DirtyFalse_NoFileIO**
GIVEN dirty flag = `false`
WHEN `OnApplicationPause(true)` fires
THEN no `File.Replace` or `File.Move` called; `save.json` modification timestamp unchanged (AC-06)

**Pause_OnApplicationFocus_NoWrite**
GIVEN dirty flag = `true`
WHEN `OnApplicationFocus(false)` fires (not `OnApplicationPause`)
THEN no write initiated; dirty flag remains `true` (AC-07)

**Pause_DirtyTrue_SynchronousWrite**
GIVEN dirty flag = `true`, `FakeFileSystem.WriteDelay = 50ms`
WHEN `OnApplicationPause(true)` fires
THEN `_writeLock.Wait()` acquired synchronously, write-then-swap completes before callback returns (AC-08)

**Pause_WriteSuccess_DirtyFlagCleared**
GIVEN dirty flag = `true`, write succeeds
WHEN `OnApplicationPause(true)` fires
THEN dirty flag = `false` after write (AC-09)

**Pause_WriteIOException_DirtyFlagRetained**
GIVEN dirty flag = `true`, `FakeFileSystem` throws `IOException`
WHEN `OnApplicationPause(true)` fires
THEN dirty flag remains `true`, exception logged, game remains playable (AC-09)

**Pause_W2AfterW1_DirtyCheckPostLock**
GIVEN W-1 executing (lock held via `FakeFileSystem.WriteDelay`)
WHEN `OnApplicationPause(true)` fires
THEN W-2 blocks on `_writeLock.Wait()`, W-1 completes and clears dirty, W-2 acquires lock, checks dirty = `false`, performs no I/O (GDD C.1 no-duplicate-write)

**Pause_CancellationToken_OperationCanceledSilently**
GIVEN `destroyCancellationToken` cancelled while W-2 is blocked in `_writeLock.Wait()`
WHEN `OperationCanceledException` propagates
THEN caught silently, dirty flag remains `true`, no write occurs, no exception propagates outside `OnApplicationPause`, `save.json` unchanged (AC-42)

**Pause_AsyncVoidForbidden_CompileCheck**
WHEN `OnApplicationPause` method signature inspected via reflection
THEN method is `void OnApplicationPause(bool)`, not `async void` (control manifest forbidden pattern)

### S3-06 — SP: Schema Versioning + Migration Runner
**Test file**: `tests/unit/save-persistence/SaveSystem_Migration_Test.cs`
**Estimated test count**: ~12 unit tests
**GDD refs**: AC-14, AC-17, AC-18, AC-22, AC-29, AC-31, AC-34; GDD C.2

#### Test cases

**Migration_V0_RunsMigrateToV1**
GIVEN `save.json` with `schema_version = 0` (flat layout: `current_level_id`, `completion_record[]`, `coin_balance` at root)
WHEN cold start executes
THEN `migrate_v0_to_v1` runs, resulting file has nested `level_progress` + `economy` structure, `schema_version = 1` (AC-14)

**Migration_AbsentSchemaVersion_TreatedAsV0**
GIVEN `save.json` valid JSON with NO `schema_version` key
WHEN cold start executes
THEN treated as v0 — migration runs, NOT treated as R-1 (AC-18)

**Migration_V0_UndoStackInitialized**
GIVEN v0 `save.json` (no `undo_stack` field)
WHEN `migrate_v0_to_v1` runs
THEN resulting in-memory state has `undo_stack = []` (empty array, not absent) (GDD C.2)

**Migration_V0_CompletionVersionNotSynthesized**
GIVEN v0 `save.json` with completion records that have no `completion_version` field
WHEN `migrate_v0_to_v1` runs
THEN migrated records leave `completion_version` absent — migration does NOT backfill a value (GDD C.2, write-once contract)

**Migration_Idempotency_RunTwiceProducesSameResult**
GIVEN in-memory v0 state
WHEN `migrate_v0_to_v1` runs once (result A), then runs again on result A (result B)
THEN A == B field-for-field (AC-34)

**Migration_CompletionVersion_WriteOnceNotMutated**
GIVEN `completion_record[N].completion_version = "2026.04"` in migrating file
WHEN any migration runs
THEN `completion_version` remains `"2026.04"` — migration does NOT overwrite it (AC-22)

**Migration_R5_FutureSchema_FileNotOverwritten**
GIVEN `save.json` with `schema_version = 99` (> `MAX_KNOWN_VERSION = 1`)
WHEN cold start executes with `sp.downgrade_notice_shown = 0` in prefs
THEN file NOT overwritten, defaults loaded, analytics warning emitted, notice shown once, `sp.downgrade_notice_shown = 1` written with `PlayerPrefs.Save()`, `IsReady = true` (AC-17)

**Migration_R5_SecondColdStart_NoticeNotRepeated**
GIVEN second cold start with same R-5 file, `sp.downgrade_notice_shown = 1`
WHEN cold start executes
THEN notice NOT shown, defaults still loaded (AC-17)

**Migration_WriteBackFails_InMemoryStateRetained**
GIVEN post-migration write-back throws `IOException` (injected via `FakeFileSystem`)
WHEN exception caught
THEN in-memory migrated state retained (not reverted), dirty flag = `true`, failure logged with migrated-from schema version, `IsReady = true`, migration re-runs on next cold start (AC-29)

**Migration_MaxKnownVersion_MatchesGdd**
WHEN `SaveSystem.MaxKnownVersion` constant inspected
THEN value == 1 (matches GDD Formulas `MAX_KNOWN_VERSION`) (AC-31 — CI lint-level assertion)

**Migration_WriteBack_SynchronousInAwake**
GIVEN migration runs during `Awake()`
WHEN write-back executes
THEN no `await` expression present — synchronous `void` path only (GDD C.5, control manifest)

### S3-07 — SP: PlayerPrefs Audio Prefs
**Test file**: `tests/unit/save-persistence/SaveSystem_PlayerPrefs_Test.cs`
**Estimated test count**: ~7 unit tests
**GDD refs**: AC-02, AC-10; GDD C.3

#### Test cases

**PlayerPrefs_AllWritesAreScalar**
WHEN all `PlayerPrefs.Set*()` calls in `SaveSystem.cs` are enumerated (static analysis or reflection)
THEN every call is `SetFloat`, `SetInt`, or `SetString`; no `SetString` with JSON content, no arrays (AC-02)

**PlayerPrefs_SaveCalledAfterEveryWrite**
WHEN each `PlayerPrefs.Set*()` call site is inspected
THEN `PlayerPrefs.Save()` is called in the same method before returning (AC-10)

**PlayerPrefs_AudioKeys_MatchSpec**
WHEN `audio.sfx_volume`, `audio.ambient_volume`, `audio.ui_volume` keys are written
THEN key strings match exactly (case-sensitive) per GDD C.3 table

**PlayerPrefs_QtsKey_MatchSpec**
WHEN `qts.tier` key (or `qts.tier_value` / `qts.tier_source` per QTS GDD) is referenced
THEN key strings match GDD C.3 and QTS GDD EC-QT-05 spec

**PlayerPrefs_SpKey_DowngradeNoticeMatchSpec**
WHEN `sp.downgrade_notice_shown` key is written
THEN key string matches exactly; written as `int` (0 or 1)

**PlayerPrefs_SaveSystem_DoesNotMediateAudioOrQtsWrites**
WHEN `SaveSystem.cs` is searched for `PlayerPrefs.Set*` with `audio.*` or `qts.*` keys
THEN zero results — those writes belong to AudioSystem and QTS respectively (GDD C.4 W-3)

**PlayerPrefs_SetCoinBalance_SetsInMemoryAndMarksDirty**
GIVEN `SaveSystem.IsReady = true`
WHEN `SaveSystem.SetCoinBalance(250)` called
THEN in-memory `economy.coin_balance = 250`, dirty flag = `true`, no write triggered directly (GDD Interactions: Coin Economy)

### S3-08 — SP ↔ GSM Integration: Board Persistence Round-Trip
**Test file**: `tests/integration/save-persistence/GSM_SavePersistence_Integration_Test.cs`
**Estimated test count**: ~6 integration tests
**GDD refs**: AC-39, AC-41; GDD Interactions: Game State Manager

#### Test cases

**Integration_UndoStack_RoundTrip_5Entries**
GIVEN GSM has 5 committed moves in undo history (board state X)
WHEN `OnApplicationPause(true)` fires → SaveSystem written → new cold start → GSM calls `GetUndoStack()`
THEN GSM restores undo queue with exactly those 5 entries in correct order; `GetUndoStack()` returns empty list would be a failure (AC-39)

**Integration_BoltCount_InvariantAcrossSerialization**
GIVEN board with N total bolts (color stacks + temp slots)
WHEN board state serialized on pause → cold start → GSM loads from `GetUndoStack()` and board snapshot
THEN total bolt count after load == N before serialization

**Integration_UndoStack_Cap20_OldestDiscarded**
GIVEN GSM accumulates 21 committed moves
WHEN save write executes
THEN `undo_stack[]` in `save.json` has exactly 20 entries; entry at index 0 is move #2 (oldest discarded was move #1) (AC-41)

**Integration_EmptyUndoStack_ColdStart_NotAnError**
GIVEN `save.json` with absent or empty `undo_stack`
WHEN cold start → GSM calls `GetUndoStack()`
THEN returns empty list; GSM treats as "no undo available"; no exception thrown (GDD C.2)

**Integration_DirtyFlag_SetOnGsmMutation**
GIVEN GSM commits a move (board state mutated)
WHEN dirty flag on SaveSystem is queried
THEN dirty flag = `true` (GSM mutation notifies SaveSystem via interface — verify integration contract)

### S3-10 — QTS: GPU Tier Detection + Adaptive Quality Settings
**Test file**: `tests/unit/quality-tier-system/TierDetection_Test.cs`
**Estimated test count**: ~22 unit tests
**GDD refs**: AC-QT-01 through AC-QT-16, EC-QT-01, EC-QT-03, EC-QT-06, EC-QT-09, EC-QT-10

**Prerequisites**: `ISystemInfoProvider` stub and `IPrefsProvider` stub injected into `TierDetectionService`.

#### Test cases — `detect_tier()` formula branches

**Detect_Android_PerfClass_HIGH_ReturnsHigh_SkipsLowerSignals**
GIVEN platform = Android, API = 31, `perf_class = HIGH`, no persisted tier
WHEN `TierDetectionService.Resolve(prefs, systemInfo)` called
THEN result = High; stub records 0 calls to `graphicsShaderLevel` and `graphicsMemorySize` (AC-QT-03)

**Detect_Android_PerfClass_LOW_ReturnsLow_SkipsLowerSignals**
GIVEN platform = Android, API = 31, `perf_class = LOW`, no persisted tier
WHEN `Resolve()` called
THEN result = Low; 0 calls to lower-priority signals (AC-QT-04)

**Detect_ShaderLevel_Below35_ReturnsLow_SkipsGpuMem**
GIVEN platform = iOS, `graphicsShaderLevel = 20`, no persisted tier
WHEN `Resolve()` called
THEN result = Low; 0 calls to `graphicsMemorySize` (AC-QT-05)

**Detect_ShaderLevel_0_ReturnsLow_NotUnavailable**
GIVEN `graphicsShaderLevel = 0`, no persisted tier
WHEN `Resolve()` called
THEN result = Low (valid Low trigger — not UNAVAILABLE) (AC-QT-05b)

**Detect_ShaderLevel_46Plus_ReturnsHigh_SkipsGpuMem** _(two sub-cases: 46 and 500)_
GIVEN `graphicsShaderLevel = 46` (case A) / `500` (case B), no persisted tier
WHEN `Resolve()` called
THEN result = High; 0 calls to `graphicsMemorySize` in both cases (AC-QT-06)

**Detect_ShaderLevel_Inconclusive_ReadsGpuMem**
GIVEN `graphicsShaderLevel = 40`, `graphicsMemorySize = 1024`, no persisted tier
WHEN `Resolve()` called
THEN result = Medium; stub records call to `graphicsMemorySize` (AC-QT-07)

**Detect_GpuMem_Below512_ReturnsLow_WithBoundaries** _(boundary cases: 511 → Low; 512 → Medium)_
GIVEN `graphicsShaderLevel = 40` (inconclusive), `graphicsMemorySize = 256` / `511` / `512`
WHEN `Resolve()` called
THEN 256 → Low; 511 → Low; 512 → Medium (AC-QT-08)

**Detect_GpuMem_512to1535_ReturnsMedium_WithBoundaries** _(boundary: 512, 1535, 1536)_
GIVEN `graphicsShaderLevel = 40` (inconclusive), `graphicsMemorySize = 512` / `1535` / `1536`
WHEN `Resolve()` called
THEN 512 → Medium; 1535 → Medium; 1536 → High (AC-QT-09)

**Detect_GpuMem_1536Plus_ReturnsHigh_WithBoundary**
GIVEN `graphicsShaderLevel = 40` (inconclusive), `graphicsMemorySize = 2048` / `1536`
WHEN `Resolve()` called
THEN 2048 → High; 1536 → High (AC-QT-10)

**Detect_AllSignalsInconclusive_ReturnsMediumFallback**
GIVEN platform = iOS, `graphicsShaderLevel = 40`, `graphicsMemorySize = 0`, no persisted tier
WHEN `Resolve()` called
THEN result = Medium (fallback — all signals exhausted) (AC-QT-11)

**Detect_GpuMem0_IsUnavailable_NotLow**
GIVEN `graphicsShaderLevel = 40` (inconclusive), `graphicsMemorySize = 0`, no persisted tier
WHEN `Resolve()` called
THEN result = Medium (not Low) — 0 is UNAVAILABLE per EC-QT-01 amendment (AC-QT-12)

**Detect_PersistedTier_SkipsDetectionEntirely**
GIVEN `qts.tier_value = "Medium"`, `qts.tier_source = "auto-detected"` in prefs stub, no detection needed
WHEN `Resolve()` called
THEN result = Medium; stub records 0 calls to systemInfo (AC-QT-02)

**Detect_PlayerOverride_WritesPrefsAndEmitsEvent**
GIVEN system in ACTIVE_AUTO state, tier = Low
WHEN `QualityTierService.SetTier(High)` called
THEN prefs writes `qts.tier_value = "High"` AND `qts.tier_source = "player-override"`; profile applier mock called with High; `tier_changed(High, player-override)` emitted — all three asserted independently (AC-QT-13)

**Detect_ResetToAuto_ReRunsDetection**
GIVEN system in ACTIVE_OVERRIDE state with player-set tier = High
WHEN `QualityTierService.ResetTier()` called
THEN systemInfo stub is called (detection re-runs); prefs writes `qts.tier_source = "auto-detected"`; detected tier's profile applied (not High) (AC-QT-14)

**Detect_GetActiveTier_NeverNullInActiveState** _(one sub-case per detection path)_
GIVEN system completed detection or loaded a persisted tier
WHEN `GetActiveTier()` called
THEN returns exactly one of {Low, Medium, High} — never null or throws (AC-QT-15)

**Detect_GetActiveTier_BeforeActive_ReturnsMediumWithWarning**
GIVEN `QualityTierService` not yet initialized
WHEN `GetActiveTier()` called
THEN returns Medium, Unity log contains warning, no exception thrown (AC-QT-16)

**Detect_UnknownPerfClass_TreatedAsUnavailable**
GIVEN `devicePerformanceClass` returns an unrecognized value (e.g., `4`)
WHEN `Resolve()` called
THEN falls through to shader level (UNAVAILABLE path); no silent fall-through (EC-QT-03)

**Detect_iOS_PerfClassNeverCalled**
GIVEN platform = iOS
WHEN `Resolve()` called
THEN stub records 0 calls to `devicePerformanceClass` — iOS skips directly to shader level (EC-QT-06)

**Detect_RapidSetTier_LastWriteWins**
GIVEN 3 consecutive `SetTier()` calls within one frame: Low, High, Medium
WHEN prefs and profile are inspected after frame
THEN prefs reflects Medium; profile applier's last call was with Medium (EC-QT-10)

**Detect_VSyncCount_SetToZeroBeforeTargetFrameRate**
GIVEN Low tier detected → `targetFrameRate = 30`
WHEN profile application executes
THEN `QualitySettings.vSyncCount = 0` is set BEFORE `Application.targetFrameRate = 30` (EC-QT-09)

## Manual QA Checklist

### S3-04 (Advisory) — iOS Cold-Start Retry on Physical Device

**Evidence file**: `production/qa/evidence/ac-28-ios-cold-start.md`
**Sign-off**: Lead programmer
**Carry to**: Alpha gate (no physical device available in current environment)

- [ ] Device rebooted, app launched before first unlock
- [ ] Pass case: file accessible within 5s → data loads correctly (same as AC-13)
- [ ] Fail case (simulated via instrumentation): 5s timeout → defaults loaded, `first_unlock_read_failure` event logged, no file written during retry window
- [ ] Retry loop does not produce visible hitch on loading screen (subjective: each 250ms yield is imperceptible)

## Smoke Test Scope

Critical paths to verify via `/smoke-check sprint` before QA hand-off:

1. App launches without crash in Unity Editor (EditMode suite)
2. `SaveSystem.Awake()` completes synchronously — `IsReady = true` before any other system's `Start()`
3. Cold start with no `save.json` → `current_level_id = 1`, `coin_balance = 0`, `IsReady = true`
4. Cold start with valid `save.json` → all fields load correctly
5. `OnApplicationPause(true)` with dirty state → `save.json` exists and is valid JSON after callback
6. `save.tmp` does NOT exist at session end (cleanup verified via `File.Exists` assertion)
7. QTS `detect_tier()` returns one of `{Low, Medium, High}` — never null or exception — in Unity Editor
8. All existing 309 baseline tests still pass (Sort Mechanic, GSM, LDS, integration suite)
9. No new `InvalidOperationException` or `MissingReferenceException` in Editor console log
10. `SaveSystem` cold-start read < 2ms for valid <22 KB save file (control manifest guardrail)

## Playtest Requirements

No stories in Sprint 3 require playtest validation. Save & Persistence and Quality Tier System are infrastructure systems — correctness is fully covered by automated tests and advisory device evidence.

## Definition of Done — Sprint 3

A story is DONE when ALL of the following are true:

- [ ] All BLOCKING acceptance criteria verified via automated test result (test file exists and passes) OR documented manual evidence at `production/qa/evidence/`
- [ ] Advisory criteria: evidence document at `production/qa/evidence/[ac-id].md` OR explicitly noted as deferred to Alpha gate in the story file's Completion Notes
- [ ] `IFileSystem` injection seam implemented before any write story begins (prerequisite for S3-03, S3-04, S3-05, S3-08)
- [ ] Control manifest forbidden patterns verified absent:
  - `async void Awake()` — compile-level check
  - `async void OnApplicationPause()` — compile-level check
  - `File.Move(source, dest, overwrite: true)` 3-arg — compile/test-level check
  - `[SerializeField]` on properties or events — compile-level check
- [ ] Smoke check passes (run `/smoke-check sprint` before QA hand-off)
- [ ] All 309+ local EditMode tests green (CI status: WAIVED per TD-CI-001)
- [ ] No regressions in Sort Mechanic, GSM, or LDS test suites
- [ ] Code reviewed via `/code-review` or documented peer review
- [ ] Story file updated to `Status: Complete` via `/story-done`
- [ ] `production/epics/index.md` updated for SP and QTS story counts after story files are created
